ashwin: quick alert — vault transit unwraps for europe-west2 around 09:12 UTC are not appearing in our KMS audit exports. seeing unwraps in Vault audit but no matching KMS logs for several entries.

maria: yikes. any chance this is an RBAC deny? which method name are you checking for?

ashwin: checking for AsymmetricDecrypt and cryptoKeyVersions access. sample from vault audit (redacted ids):
```
vault audit: 2026-06-01T09:11:58Z transit/unwrap id=cty-7a2f europe-west2 key=wrap-key v=8
vault audit: 2026-06-01T09:12:03Z transit/unwrap id=cty-7a3b europe-west2 key=wrap-key v=8
```
but gcloud logging read returned only us-west1 hits for that minute.

tanvi: can you paste the logging query you used? I'll cross-check BigQuery export.

ashwin: used: `gcloud logging read "resource.type=kms_crypto_key protoPayload.methodName=\"google.cloud.kms.v1.KeyManagementService.AsymmetricDecrypt\" timestamp>\"2026-06-01T09:10:00Z\"" --project=ai-prod`

sec-oncall: I'm running a quick audit-forwarder health check. last deploy shows forwarder v2.9.0. grabbing forwarder logs for eu cluster: `kubectl -n infra logs audit-forwarder-0 --since=30m`

sre-bot: infra deploy: audit-forwarder v2.9.0 scaled to 4 replicas at 2026-06-01T09:05:20Z :white_check_mark:

auditor-bot: snapshot created gs://redwood-audit-backups/2026-06-01/3950001234-snap.json (sha256:abc123, size=9MB)

maria: forwarder logs show intermittent errors then a partition drop for europe-west2: 
```
[2026-06-01T09:10:45Z] forwarder ERROR: stream read failed: rpc error: code = INTERNAL desc = "connection reset"
[2026-06-01T09:11:20Z] forwarder WARN: processed gap for region europe-west2 partition 3, gap_size=6s, policy=skip
```
this smells like a pipeline skip, not an IAM failure.

tanvi: blast radius mapping: which services are allowed to use europe-west2/wrap-key? policy shows: vault-transit-eu, partner-ingest-eu, data-exports. I'll pull vault audit to map ciphertext ids to secret paths.

ashwin: thanks. I also attempted a binary replay from the forwarder admin interface; it replayed most events but 7 records failed with `base64: invalid input` during decode. suspect partner-produced payloads with unexpected padding.

sec-oncall: priority runbook proposal: 1) create snapshot (done), 2) attempt focused replay for the failed offsets, 3) if replay unsuccessful, perform targeted rewrap for ciphertexts created during gap window (09:11:40-09:11:58 UTC), 4) rotate key version afterwards. want to avoid global write freeze unless owners request it.

maria: agree with staged approach. start with readonly mode for vault-transit-eu to stop new unwraps while we rehydrate and rewrap. notify owners before any rotation.

auditor-bot: automated ticket SEC-5791 created, label=needs-owner-notify, followup at 2026-06-01T10:00:00Z.

tanvi: mapping update: 5 of the 7 failed unwraps map to low-sensitivity metrics secrets, 2 map to partner-ingest-eu API keys (high sensitivity). DMing partner owners now and requesting immediate credential rotation for those two.

ashwin: prepping rewrap plan. I'll create a new key version v9 and stage alias update. commands I'll run (dry-run first):
```bash
# create new key version
gcloud kms keys versions create --key=wrap-key --keyring=rdrw --location=europe-west2 --project=ai-prod
# test rewrap for ciphertext
vault write -field=ciphertext transit/rewrap ciphertext=cty-7a3b new_key=projects/ai-prod/locations/europe-west2/keyRings/rdrw/cryptoKeys/wrap-key/cryptoKeyVersions/9
```
keeping v8 as fallback during rolling rewrap.

maria: also recommend adding stricter proto/schema validation in forwarder and a retry queue for decode failures. filing INFRA-3380.

sec-oncall: action items recap:
- tanvi: confirm owner rotation for partner creds (done/ongoing)
- ashwin: dry-run rewrap and then run targeted rewrap for high-sensitivity secrets
- maria: attempt binary replay and capture raw failed payloads for analysis
- infra (INFRA-3380): add replay retry queue + proto validation
- sec-oncall: authorize readonly window for vault-transit-eu until rewrap completes if owners request it

sre-bot: monitor alert set: watch audit-forwarder restarts > 1/5m -> notify #eng-sre and #eng-security.

auditor-bot: rewrap job recorded: SEC-5791-REWRAP, 2 high-sensitivity secrets targeted.

ashwin: dry-run rewrap for cty-7a3b succeeded and unwrap against v9 validated. starting rewrap for the 2 partner creds now; will update on success/failure per secret.

maria: nice. follow-up: schedule a 1-week postmortem to review forwarder gap and partner payload encodings. invite infra, partner-eng, and security.

sec-oncall: thanks everyone. keep updates concise here and DM owners for sensitive details.

(END)
